item.title: UAAGI On The Move Offers Takes Over SM Mall Of Asia This February 26 To March 1
item.description: UAAGI Auto Group announces the return of its flagship roadshow event this 2026: UAAGI On the Move. This premier one-stop-shop vehicle display and test drive extravaganza happens at the SM Mall of Asia Central Atrium from Thursday, February 26 to Sunday, March 1, 2026.Read More »

item.title: Mitsubishi Motors PH Has Produced Its 900,000th L300

item.title: The Honda City RS Hatchback Goes Beyond Logic
item.description: There are few cars that are legitimately fun to drive here in the Philippines without shelling out premium money. If you want more power, space, and the same car and machine engagement - then look at the Honda City RS Hatchback. item.title: MIAS 2026 Expands Footprint With Return Of PTTC As Additional Venue
item.description: The Manila International Auto Show (MIAS) is set to become even bigger in 2026 as it officially announces the return of the Philippine Trade Training Center (PTTC) as an additional and connected exhibition venue. The motoring event will take place from April 9 to 12, 2026, with its main exhibition continuing at the World Trade Center Metro Manila (WTCMM) while expanding into the PTTC for the first time after eight years.Read More »

item.title: Ford Mustang Mach-E Has Highest Owner Satisfaction Among Mass Market EV Brands
item.description: The Ford Mustang Mach‑E has been recognized as the top ranked battery electric vehicle when it comes to ownership. This is based on the 2026 JD Power U.S. Electric Vehicle Experience (EVX) Ownership Study.Read More »
